title: Plane geometry: area and angles
observableEvidence: Computes the area of a composite plane figure by inferring a rectangular cutout's dimensions and subtracting its area.
Uses a straight-line angle total and an equal split to find an unknown angle.
masteryCheckRule: Require one independent straight-line angle solution with the subtraction and equal split shown and one delayed check that infers missing rectangular-cutout dimensions and finds the composite area by subtraction.
